layouts.name: Hedge Hollow Circuit
layouts.description: Draft identification from a uniquely connected OSM course with a matching layout name. Private reference start/finish GPS supports the venue association. Named source geometry and configuration still require visual review.

layouts.name: Hedge Hollow Outer
layouts.description: Draft configuration: Outer course with north shoulder, concave eastern bend and direct western straight; excludes the extra western notch. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 4621.3 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap course and venue identity
sources.evidenceNote: Venue identity and trace coordinates come from the pinned OSM extract. The source identity identifies the facility; course configuration is provisional. No privately sourced coordinates enter the public database.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap explicitly selected circuit branches

sources.title: Configuration identification reference

sources.title: Reusable aerial imagery for estimated road borders
